Shortly after the [[Capture of the Dread Masters|capture]] of the six [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] known as the [[Dread Masters]] in [[3668 BBY]] during the [[Great Galactic War]], an attempt by the Dread Masters to break out of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Belsavis prison|prison complex]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] led to a '''short battle''' above the planet. After the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] were moved to the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] district of [[Section X]] to ensure that they would not harm other inmates, the six reached out to an [[Dread Masters' apprentice|apprentice]] of theirs and ordered him to bring the ''[[Fatality]]''&mdash;a warship of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] that carried dozens of elite [[HK-51 series assassin droid|HK-51 assassin droids]]&mdash;to Belsavis so that they could break out. However, the prison's defenses destroyed the ''Fatality'' in orbit, sending the heavily damaged warship crashing into a [[Frozen Lake|frozen lake]] near Section X.

==Prelude==
In [[3668 BBY]], during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a strike team composed of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaric Kaedan]] and a [[Republic Special Forces Division]] unit [[Capture of the Dread Masters|managed to capture]] the six [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] known as the [[Dread Masters]] with the help of the Republic's intelligence agency, the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]]. The Dread Masters, who were capable of using a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] version of [[Battle meditation/Legends|battle meditation]] to inspire crippling fear in their opponents, were sent to the Republic's secret [[Belsavis prison|prison complex]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].<ref name="Gnost" />

==The battle==
However, the Dread Masters were able to reach out to [[Dread Masters' apprentice|one of their apprentices]] and ordered him to steal the ''[[Fatality]]'', an Imperial destroyer that was carrying dozens of the highly advanced [[HK-51]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]], and break them out of prison. The apprentice complied with their orders, bringing the ''Fatality'' to Belsavis&mdash;a location which the Republic had worked hard to ensure that the Empire never discovered.<ref name="The Fatality" /> Fortunately for the Republic, the rest of the Empire was unaware of the apprentice's purpose or location,<ref name="Fatal Errors">{{TORcite|type=heroic|Fatal Errors|Belsavis}}</ref> so when the prison's defenses shot down the ''Fatality'' over the district of [[Section X]], the Republic's secret prison remained secret. However, the Republic was unaware that the ''Fatality'' was not destroyed on impact, but had in fact crashed into a [[Frozen Lake|frozen lake]] near Section X where it would remain for the next three decades.<ref name="The Fatality" />

==Aftermath==
The HK-51 droids aboard the ''Fatality'' remained frozen and deactivated until [[3639 BBY]], when the recently-freed Dread Masters brought the [[Dread Host|Dread Guard]]&mdash;an army of Imperials and other individuals under their mental control&mdash;back to Section X and began to excavate the destroyer while also pursuing other goals in the area.<ref name="The Fatality" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle above Belsavis was first mentioned in several promotional releases for Game Update 1.5 of the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'',<ref name="Com">{{TORweb|url=info/news/blog/20121102|text=Community Developer Blog: HK-51 Classified Intel}}</ref> as the update featured the addition of Section X and a series of missions that allowed players to acquire HK-51 as a companion.<ref name="Devel">{{TORweb|url=info/media/trailers/developer-dispatch-hk-51-activated|text=Developer Dispatch: HK-51 Activated}}</ref> It was later expanded on in the Republic and Imperial missions in Section X, giving the battle a date and background.<ref name="The Fatality" />
